## Checklist

- [ ] I added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) for changes to a published package, or none is needed
- [ ] I updated the docs for new or changed options (`pnpm docs:build` passes)
- [ ] UI changes have an axe check and screenshots
- [ ] No secrets, real keys or real customer data in the code, tests or screenshots
